title: Nothing in a cloud run can resolve to claude: refuse any run whose FINAL resolved runner is not pi on GLM
description:
Triaged 2026-09-23 from xte's close-out, which held on untriaged findings; the finding keys it absorbs are in this tick's notes. xte was merged as building blocks (operator's choice B) and its unmet goal moved here, because it is the same single cloud path yoh reconciles.

OPERATOR RULE: nothing in the cloud runs claude. Three findings say routing can still land there:
  - dd60e88c (HIGH): a cloud role cell with no kind, or a tier applied after it, dispatches the claude CLI in the container - the compiled-in default leaks through.
  - ea1a62d3: tier overlays bypass cloud overlays, so a tier the cloud cell did not sanction routes a worker the container cannot call.
  - 577272d7: the refusal must look at the FINAL resolved runner, after every overlay, not at the declared cell.
The fix is a refusal at run start, naming the role and the tier, over the fully resolved worker - never a check of one layer.
acceptance_criteria: A cloud run whose fully resolved runner for any role at any tier is not pi on a GLM model refuses at start and names the role and tier; tests cover a cell with no kind, a tier overlay after the cloud cell, and the compiled-in default; and the full suites pass
